request.style: English, male solo voice with rich choir, piano, strings, thunder sounds, cinematic, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Heavenly beings lift your voice
Give the glory that he deserves
Give the strength that he has

[Pre-Chorus]
The name is great and holy
Bow down in his presence

[Chorus]
Ascribe to the Lord the glory
Of his name in the light
Worship the Lord in the splendor
Of holiness tonight

[Verse]
His voice is over the waters
God of glory thunders
Over the mighty deep places
Powerful and full of majesty

[Pre-Chorus]
The name is great and holy
Bow down in his presence

[Chorus]
Ascribe to the Lord the glory
Of his name in the light
Worship the Lord in the splendor
Of holiness tonight

[Verse]
He shatters the cedars
The cedars of Lebanon
The voice breaks the forest
The power is upon us

[Chorus]
Ascribe to the Lord the glory
Of his name in the light
Worship the Lord in the splendor
Of holiness tonight

[Outro]
Splendor of holiness
Glory to the Lord
